narrative.overview: Relay files each support request as a carbonless multi-part service form; each pipeline stage stamps its own ply. Dark only, forest-black ground, flat square fields, hard-step motion. The Relay Full Demo is the design authority.
keyCharacteristics: Radius 0, no shadows, blur or gradients
Archivo Narrow caps, Courier Prime numbers, Public Sans reading
Yellow is the live ply; coral is urgent only

rules.name: The Yellow Is Live Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks the one ply in progress and nothing else (the ops badge for processing uses it as ink). Never use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Coral Is Urgent Rule
rules.body: Coral is for urgent priority and field errors. No other use.

rules.name: The Field Edge Rule
rules.body: A control boundary uses `rule-forest` (`input`), which clears 3:1. `form-rule` and `hair-forest` are decorative ruling only; never put them on a control. This `input` value is a listed deviation from the demo.

rules.name: The Ink Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every ply has its own ink (`ink-on-ply`, `ink-on-orange`, `ink-on-yellow`, forest, bone). Do not pair a ply with another ply's ink.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Caps labels never carry sentences; Courier never carries prose; Public Sans never prints a label.

rules.name: The No Easing Rule
rules.body: Every transition is a hard step. No fades, springs or cubic-bezier curves.

dos: take values from `tokens.css` variables; add a token in the JSON first, then run `bun run tokens`.
keep every state change a hard step (90ms `steps(2)` or the stepped print).
print labels in Archivo Narrow caps, numbers in Courier Prime, sentences in Public Sans.
wrap new form surfaces in FormPanel so ruling and form colours come for free.
give each ply its own ink and keep the live ply the only yellow.
donts: add a light theme, a theme toggle, rounded corners, shadows, blur, gradients or glow.
use coral for anything but urgent and errors.
put a decorative rule colour on a control boundary.
put architecture or tech detail on the site, or copy the retired violet/starfield look.
hardcode hex in components (the only literals are the theme-color meta tag, the two breakpoints, and email inline styles).

knownItems: Ops list on 375px clips the Subject column without an ellipsis (cosmetic; the drawer shows the full title).
The empty gap above NOTIFY ME / SUBMIT on a phone is the Turnstile slot reserved for Cloudflare's 65px widget; it only looks empty when the widget is stubbed in captures.
On hold always sits on ply 4 with plies 1 to 3 painted done, as in the demo.
The two within-a-minute /new copy lines are kept by decision.
